final_rows.comment: Entities mapped using model labels and pathway knowledge. RAS family expanded to HRAS/KRAS/NRAS; SOS expanded to SOS1/SOS2. Protein phosphorylation and 'negative feedback phosphorylated' forms mapped to their base protein names (no 'phosphorylated' modifier) except where species represent inhibitor-bound forms (marked as complexes including sorafenib). Ligand-bound or multi-protein species were annotated as complexes and decomposed into their distinct protein and small-molecule components (e.g., Ras-GTP species include Ras + GTP). Chemical synonyms included common drug/trivial names where relevant.
